title: Django or Flask cookie configured with SameSite=None in python — review required
description: A framework setting assigns samesite="None" to session or CSRF cookies. The value opts the cookie into cross-site delivery; paired with a missing Secure flag it is rejected by browsers, and paired with Secure it still widens request exposure. The rule flags the literal setting.
remediation: Use Lax unless a documented cross-site flow requires None, and set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE and CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE when None is required.
limitation: Lexical: matches a literal samesite assignment; settings loaded from environment variables are out of scope.
